description.narrative: Work Package 2 focused on researching and piloting the first commercial vegetable seedling nursery in Ghana. Simba Grow Ltd., in partnership with Truvalu through the GrowPact Global initiative, began piloting two low-tech nurseries. These pilots are designed to test the technical and commercial viability of commercial seedling production in Ghana. The initial production cycles focused on tomato seedlings at Anloga in the Volta Region. During the first production cycle, 253,762 hybrid tomato seedlings were produced and sold to 31 farmers. A business plan is also under development for the establishment of the first commercial vegetable seedling nursery. This plan is to attract long-term investment to ensure operational sustainability.
